name: Rohit Sharma
review: The entire process felt refreshingly professional — from the video valuation call to pickup, everything was on time and the payment hit my account before the driver even left.

name: Anjali Mehta
review: I was dreading the RC cancellation paperwork more than losing the car. Their team handled the entire RTO process and sent me the closure certificate within two weeks.

name: Vikram Singh
review: Got a noticeably better quote than two other scrap dealers I called. Transparent pricing, no last-minute deductions at pickup — exactly what they quoted is what I received.

name: Priya Nair
review: Our office had six old fleet vehicles to dispose of. Their corporate team coordinated pickup across two locations and gave us a single consolidated compliance report.

name: Arjun Kapoor
review: Smooth experience overall. Inspection was quick and the pickup team was courteous. Would have liked slightly faster scheduling, but the payment and paperwork were flawless.

name: Sneha Reddy
review: Loved that they explained exactly where the materials go and how much CO₂ gets offset. Felt good knowing my old scooter wasn't just dumped somewhere.
